intro: Back to Billy is a step in the ongoing feud between the Stonefield and Maclure families in central Elwynn Forest. Having gathered the ingredients for a pork belly pie, you carry the freshly baked dish back to young Billy Maclure to extract information about Bernice Stonefield's missing necklace.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here you go. And when you give this pie to that Billy, you tell him I hope he chokes on it!

clips.title: Progress

clips.title: Completion

I think my memory is coming back to me...
